title: Edgible card test result
description: The latest result of a card's lifecycle, in test.yml beside card.yml. Committed only when the result, a step's outcome, or the images change; git history holds earlier results. No device name, hostname, organization id, or password.

tested.description: The day of the run that produced this result, YYYY-MM-DD. A rerun with the same outcome and images does not change it.

result.description: pass only when every step passed.

card-kit.description: The card-kit commit the checks came from.

machine.description: Operating system and architecture, and the Docker version. Not the device name.

images.description: Each image as it ran, ideally with its digest.

verify.description: One entry per app in card.yml.

notes.description: What a reader should know about this run, such as a step that needed a retry.
